اقتلعتما (form VIII)
# اِقْتَلَعْتُمَا (iqtalaʕtumā) /iq.ta.laʕ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
# اُقْتُلِعْتُمَا (uqtuliʕtumā) /uq.tu.liʕ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِقْتَلَعَ (iqtalaʕa)
